purpose: FOUR-ROW END-TO-END SMOKE of both KC-S1 cells before their registered 1,000-call flights. It proves, on real sealed rows, everything the two cells add to the MF-5 wiring that is already proved: the sealed-manifest predecessor binding rebuilding one state per sample from the sealed closed-list run manifest, the per-sample state fill appending the right per-intent TRAIN slot schema block, the -np 4 geometry, the entities-only response parsing through reproduction.slurp_scoring.parse_slu_response, the seal, and all three declared scorers over the complete manifest through core.scoring_batch. populations.basis: The SAME four rows the sealed closed-list wiring proof and the MF-5 SLURP phase smoke both flew: the first four DEV-1000 sample ids in sorted order. Named HERE, in the registered fragment, rather than passed on a command line, so a smoke can never quietly fly four different rows than the ones its exposure row names (the SAEA-E22-ESB precedent). Flight split identity hash e335c74149794af0f2301954b6e92cde2a4134d65ebe6069173a1a556b7a04b3, audio 15.011 s per pass.

one_run_id_two_cells: Both smoke cells share this run id and take one attempt each; core.attempts keys on (run_id, attempt_id) and the plan's budget is metered cumulatively across every attempt of the run id, which is why planned_model_calls is 24 for 8 real contacts. The two REGISTERED flights do NOT share a run id: each has its own experiment fragment, its own plan, its own exposure row and its own single recovery allowance.
budget_basis: 4 rows x 1 phase x 1 contact x 2 cells = 8 contacts, plus margin for the one permitted recovery re-registration within this run id = 24 planned model calls. The four rows' own audio is 15.011 seconds per pass and each cell makes one pass; 120 is the rounded ceiling for both cells plus a recovery. GPU hours 0.3 covers a cold model load plus eight contacts. Paid API spend 0.
gate: PASS requires, for EACH cell: 4 of 4 contacts; exactly ONE phase in the run_phases receipt with rows 4 and contacts 4; a sealed run manifest with exactly 4 canonical outputs rows, one per sample, no duplicates; a <run_id>.phases.json beside it whose sha256 the seal receipt records; every payload's last history turn role == control; the KC-S1b contact instruction equal to the KC-S1a contact instruction plus a per-sample suffix on every row; and all three declared scorers running to completion over the complete manifest through core.scoring_batch.
